body.statement: For every strict priority order \(\pi_{\ell}\), a set \(S\subseteq V\) is the WRI greedy output if and only if \(S\) is independent in \(C_G\) and every \(v\in V\setminus S\) has a neighbor \(u\in S\) that precedes \(v\) in \(\pi_{\ell}\).
body.justification: The certificate replaces a history-dependent scan by independence and earlier-neighbor domination constraints.
body.gap: Random sequential adsorption uses the same greedy mechanism, but the cited work does not formulate this certificate for heterogeneous tagged exact integration.
body.consumer: The core inclusion-exclusion argument uses the certificate to separate forest components after conditioning on core priorities.
